method: Desk research only, no estimation. Primary sources read directly from www.tcmb.gov.tr. fast.tcmb.gov.tr, binance.com/binance.tr, Reuters, Bloomberg, resmigazete.gov.tr, bddk.org.tr and Turkish news sites were not accessed directly, so those are cited only where a search snippet was seen and are flagged. No file in stablecoin_paper/tables was read.

rtgs.name: EFT (Elektronik Fon Transfer) System, part of the CBRT Payment Systems (EFT + Retail Payment System RPS for customer TRY transfers + ESTS/EMKT securities); owned and operated by the CBRT (TCMB); RTGS in central-bank money
rtgs.hours_local: Weekdays except official public holidays, 08:30-17:30 Turkey time (TRT, UTC+3, no DST); half working days close at 13:00 (which days are half days, e.g. holiday eves, is UNVERIFIED here); closed Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays. The CBRT may set different hours for customer payments / change operating days and hours.
rtgs.hours_2024_2026_changes: No change to these hours found for 2024-2026. The CBRT Payment Systems were relaunched in a redesigned architecture on 23 Feb 2024 (press release 2024-12, 1 Mar 2024), which does not mention an hours change; the CBRT page as retrieved 2026-10-22 still states 08:30-17:30.

facts.fact: CBRT Payment Systems operate weekdays except public holidays 08:30-17:30; open until 13:00 on half working days; CBRT may change hours for customer payments
Same statement in Turkish ('hafta ici her gun 08.30-17.30 ... Yarim is gunlerinde ise saat 13.00'e kadar')

Systems open automatically at 08:30 and close automatically at 17:30 on normal working days and 13:00 on half working days; RPS = Retail Payment System (Customers' Turkish Lira Transfer System) follows the same daily cycle; CBRT may change operational days and hours (PFMI disclosure, 29 Dec 2021, section 2.9)
EFT provides real-time transfer and real-time gross settlement of TRY interbank payments; interbank payments settle in <1 second, retail customer payments in ~30 seconds on average
Redesigned CBRT Payment Systems (EFT, RPS, ESTS) operational from 23 Feb 2024

rtgs.bank_level_customer_cutoff: UNVERIFIED: retail-facing sources say banks accept customer EFT orders roughly 09:00-17:00 and charge 'late EFT' fees after 17:00 (hesap.com, DenizBank fee document; seen only as search snippets, not opened).

instant_systems.name: FAST (Fonlarin Anlik ve Surekli Transferi / Instant and Continuous Transfer of Funds)
instant_systems.settlement: Payments complete within seconds and funds are immediately usable by the payee; transactions not completed within the time-out are cancelled. Participants: banks, and since 2023 qualifying payment and e-money institutions, and PTT.

per_transaction_limit_history_TRY.note: launch limit, to be raised gradually to 1,000

AUDIT ADDITION. Press release 2022-13 (14 Feb 2022) states the money-transfer limit of TRY 2,000 is raised to TRY 5,000 as of 21 Feb 2022; the same release caps FAST-TR QR merchant payments at TRY 10,000 per transaction. Also listed in the CBRT Financial Stability Report May 2022 (No. 34) measures table.

No CBRT press release on them appears in the 2022 or 2023 press-release indexes (the 2023 index has no FAST item at all), and the May 2022, Nov 2022, May 2023 and Nov 2023 Financial Stability Reports do not mention them. per_transaction_limit_history_TRY.announced: 2024-04-02 (press release 2024-16); planned and announced to participants Dec 2023

instant_systems.daily_limit: No system-level daily value cap found in CBRT sources; daily limits are set by individual banks/apps (UNVERIFIED, bank-specific).
instant_systems.night_time_limit: None found. No CBRT press release in 2024, 2025 or 2026 introduces a time-of-day (night) limit on FAST (indexes checked); unlike Brazil's PIX night limit, no Turkish equivalent was located. Any bank-level or BDDK anti-fraud night restrictions: UNVERIFIED (BDDK and Resmi Gazete sites not accessed).

other_changes.change: FAST Request-to-Pay (Odeme Iste) overlay service launched (person-to-person first)

AUDIT CORRECTION (was 'title only seen'). FAST Secure Payment Transaction (Guvenli Odeme Islemi, escrow) overlay service live from 31 May 2024 (press release 2024-32, 5 Jun 2024). It holds the amount at a FAST participant until an authorised body approves/registers the underlying deal (first use case: second-hand vehicle sales) and has an initial per-transaction limit of TRY 2 million. It is conditional escrow, not an on-demand interbank credit transfer, so it does not change the 02:00 classification. Whether the TRY 2m limit changed later: UNVERIFIED.
Announcement that payment and e-money institutions join FAST directly in 2023; FAST described as 7/24/365
AUDIT ADDITION. Request-to-Pay overlay extended to corporate users, with partial, early and deferred payment functions (press release 2025-06, 24 Jan 2025). No limit change.

AUDIT ADDITION. CBRT launched the 'Odemelerin Merkezi' payments website, which lists a 'Siper' security overlay service for FAST among CBRT payment projects (press release 2025-62). What Siper does (e.g., fraud screening, any time-of-day controls) is UNVERIFIED: odemelerinmerkezi.org was not accessed.

facts.fact: FAST lets customers send payment orders 7x24; independent of EFT; developed, operated and owned by the CBRT; pilot 18 Dec 2020, public launch 8 Jan 2021

instant_systems.name: Intra-bank transfers (havale) and card schemes (BKM)
instant_systems.note: Not interbank settlement outside RTGS hours: same-bank book transfers (havale) do not cross banks. BKM operates the Domestic Clearing and Settlement System (YTHS), which provides clearing and reconciliation of card transactions among banks (CBRT BKM page); AUDIT NOTE: that YTHS positions settle net through the CBRT systems is not stated on the CBRT page and is UNVERIFIED, but card clearing is deferred and is not an on-demand interbank credit transfer either way. No other 24/7 interbank TRY settlement system appears on the CBRT list of payment systems in Turkey (EFT/EMKT/FAST, BKM, Takasbank, MKK, GOSAS, Paycore, Bilesim).

classification_question: On an ordinary weekday at 02:00 local time, can a transfer of USD 50,000 equivalent settle between two banks within minutes?
classification_rationale: At 02:00 on a weekday EFT/RPS (RTGS) is closed (opens 08:30). The only interbank TRY system running is FAST (24/7, settles in seconds), but it has a binding per-transaction cap: TRY 50,000 until 3 Apr 2024, TRY 100,000 from 4 Apr 2024 to 25 Aug 2026, TRY 300,000 from 26 Aug 2026. USD 50,000 was about TRY 1.49m-2.48m over 2024 to Oct 2026, so it must be split into roughly 30-32 (Jan to 3 Apr 2024), 16-25 (4 Apr 2024 to 25 Aug 2026) or 9 (from 26 Aug 2026) FAST payments. The FAST escrow overlay (TRY 2m limit from 31 May 2024) does not help: it releases funds only after an authorised approval/registration of the underlying deal. The classification is LIMITED throughout 2024-2026. Whether a bank allows that many back-to-back FAST payments at night depends on the bank's own daily limits (UNVERIFIED).

documented_regulatory_constraint.fact: Since 30 Apr 2021 (Regulation on the Disuse of Crypto Assets in Payments, Official Gazette 16 Apr 2021 no. 31456), payment and e-money institutions may not intermediate fund transfers to or from crypto-asset trading, custody, transfer or issuance platforms. So TRY legs to and from exchanges must go through bank accounts (EFT/FAST/havale) or peer-to-peer.

papara_note.fact: CBRT press release 2025-34 (27 May 2025): following investigation 2024/231483, the court appointed SDIF as trustee of Papara Elektronik Para A.S. (an e-money institution), and its payment transactions became temporarily subject to daily limits.
papara_note.relevance: UNVERIFIED that Papara was a Binance TRY channel; under the 2021 regulation it could not legally intermediate exchange deposits after 30 Apr 2021.

binance_fiat_rails.typical_channels: UNVERIFIED (binance.com, binance.tr and news sources not accessed): (a) Binance TR (local entity, BN Teknoloji A.S.) takes TRY deposits and withdrawals by bank transfer from the user's own Turkish bank account (EFT during EFT hours, FAST 24/7 within the FAST cap, havale with its partner bank); (b) Binance.com lists TRY spot pairs (e.g., USDT/TRY) and runs a large TRY P2P market whose ads settle the fiat leg by Turkish bank transfer (bank names, FAST/IBAN); (c) since Law 7518 (July 2024) crypto-asset service providers in Turkey need Capital Markets Board (SPK) authorisation, which shapes which Binance entity serves Turkish residents. Not confirmed from primary sources here.

audit.method: Independent re-check by re-reading the cited CBRT primary sources (EFT pages EN/TR, PFMI disclosure section 2.9, press releases 2021-01, 2021-06, 2021-28, 2022-13, 2022-53, 2024-08, 2024-12, 2024-16, 2024-32, 2025-06, 2025-34, 2025-62, 2026-36, crypto regulation PDF, CBRT USD rates XML), the 2022-2026 Turkish and English press-release indexes, and the CBRT Financial Stability Reports May 2022-Nov 2023. No new web searches were made, and binance.tr, odemelerinmerkezi.org, www3.tcmb.gov.tr, bddk.org.tr, resmigazete.gov.tr, spk.gov.tr and fast.tcmb.gov.tr were not accessed. No estimation results were read.

FAST: 7x24, independent of EFT, CBRT-owned, settles in seconds; pilot 18 Dec 2020, public 8 Jan 2021.
